children: Flyte Aviation entered into a settlement agreement with Creatd to resolve disputes related to its acquisition of Fly Flyte and Ponderosa Air and a promissory note. The agreement replaces the $1.2 million remaining balance with a $1.074 million note payable in six monthly installments from January through June 2027, and provides for 675,000 Flyte Aviation shares in exchange for 120,000 Creatd shares, subject to listing approval. Flyte Aviation also agreed to contribute $50,000 toward certain litigation expenses; an affiliate of Creatd will continue providing services for $40,000 per month, terminable by either party on 30 days' notice.
: Global settlement and release agreement with amended and restated promissory note
